description: Example developer overrides for CMakeUserPresets.json (git-ignored). CMake 4.x forbids a user preset with the same name as a project preset, so a local dev preset must use a distinct name and 'inherits' the project preset to add a machine-specific Qt kit path. Alternatively (and simpler, keeping the exact --preset dev/asan/release names), set the CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH environment variable when configuring, e.g. 'CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH=/opt/homebrew/opt/qt cmake --preset dev'. This file is documentation only; copy what you need into CMakeUserPresets.json.

configurePresets.name: dev-local
configurePresets.displayName: dev preset with a locally installed Qt
